title: Conditional Execution Based on Results
query: Check if the server is running. If it's running, get its status. If it's not running, start it.

tools.name: get_server_status
tools.description: Get detailed server status (only works if server is running)

explanation: This demonstrates CONDITIONAL BRANCHING in workflows. Step 1 checks the condition. Steps 2a/2b execute based on the result. This is an IF-THEN-ELSE pattern: IF running THEN get_status ELSE start_server. In production agents, this logic is handled by the orchestration layer based on actual results. The notation '2a' and '2b' shows these are alternative paths, not sequential steps.
learning_points: Workflows can have conditional branches based on results
IF-THEN-ELSE patterns are common in agentic systems
Step 1 determines which path (2a or 2b) executes
Only ONE of the conditional branches executes, not both
Real agents evaluate conditions dynamically at runtime
